notes: re_share_min = 1.0 demands that wind + solar supply 100 % of generation, but coal_existing is must-run at 60 MW every hour, so the renewable share can never reach 1. No carbon cap is set, so the RE floor is the ONLY binding policy constraint. Wind (<= 600 MW) and solar (<= 800 MW) potential also caps the attainable share well below 1 at default demand. The only fix is lowering re_share_min - Tier C. Buying more wind/solar is not available as a Tier-B escape: the capex keys change cost, not the technical potential.
